title: Grilled Pork Skewers with Date Glaze
description: A sweet and savory Filipino-inspired dish featuring pork skewers glazed with a date reduction. Perfect for a summer evening or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before using

instructions: Thread pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small saucepan, combine dates, soy sauce, brown sugar, and fish sauce (if using).
Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until reduced and syrupy.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Brush with date glaze during last minute of grilling.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro).
